status: Frozen by the figure-truth author before inspecting any candidate Figure 5 reconstruction or candidate mask scores
reference: Unmodified full-size publisher figure5.png, 1972 by 978 pixels
quantity: Visible, color-specific curve support; not curve density, empirical quantiles, class frequencies, or opacity-derived population statistics
coordinate_system: Calibrate each panel from its own printed energy and intensity ticks. Map each candidate curve into those same pixel coordinates. Do not optimize translation, dilation, energy stretch, intensity stretch, or panel-specific distortions against the figure.
allowed_normalization: Divide each combined L2,3 curve by its maximum, as in the published caption. No per-edge normalization, baseline fit or independent edge registration.

color_mask.rationale: A three-code-value separation exceeds single-channel 8-bit quantization ambiguity; black axes and lettering do not satisfy either hue test. Ambiguous blended colors are not assigned to both classes. Do not invert cumulative alpha or solve for source-class populations from RGB mixtures.

tolerance_rationale: Approximately one pixel of source line width, one pixel of axis calibration uncertainty, and one pixel of resampling uncertainty. Three pixels correspond to roughly 0.3 eV horizontally and 0.0094 maximum-normalized intensity vertically. This is fixed from the retained figure resolution rather than from reconstruction errors.
mandatory_gates: All eight absorbing elements and both classes must be represented, with provenance for every plotted curve
Each of the sixteen panel-color comparisons must meet precision, recall and distance requirements separately
No source-color mask may be empty; a missing class does not count as a vacuous pass
The complete published plotting ranges must be covered; no post hoc masking of mismatching peaks, tails or unusual spectra
Reconstruct class membership from native released structures using a disclosed reproducible local-environment method
Independently replay source selection, edge pairing, environment assignment and normalization from native records

A reviewer must compare the full reconstructed plot directly with the published figure, including outlier curves, peak positions, L2 class contrasts for Mn/Fe/Co/Ni/Cu, and the distinctive high post-edge responses for Ni and Cu
The automated support result alone must never set scientific_pass to true
rendering_caution: The original author plotting code and labels are unavailable. Unresolved rendering or classification discrepancies must be reported as unresolved reproduction failures rather than being used to enlarge these tolerances. Plot support is an additional paper-result check, not a substitute for scientific comparison or raw-data provenance.
